name: THMY
recent: THMY 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日宣布拟通过私募配售最多 10% 新股，并于 11 月 25 日补充资金用途细节。公司 2026 财年第二季净利创纪录，达 RM11.59mil，带动上半年盈利超越上一财年全年。同期，EPF 在 10 月底至 11 月底期间频繁申报持股变动。
notable: 最多发行相当于现有股本 10% 的新股。
2026 财年第二季净利达 RM11.59mil，创纪录。
2026 财年上半年净利同比增长 162.6% 至 RM17.8mil。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
EPF 在近期多个交易日持续申报持股变动。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM20.23mil，净利 RM6.22mil，净利率 30.7%；营收环比增长 17.1%，净利环比增长 39.4%，净利率高于上一季度的 25.8%。

recent_en: THMY announced a proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares on 20 Nov 2026, with additional use-of-proceeds details on 25 Nov. The company posted a record 2QFY27 net profit of RM11.59mil, lifting 1H earnings above the prior full financial year. Meanwhile, EPF filed frequent changes in shareholding between late October and late November.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of existing share base.
1H27 net profit rose 162.6% year-on-year to RM17.8mil.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
EPF has been filing changes in shareholding on multiple recent trading days.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (ended 30 Jun 2026) revenue was RM20.23mil with net income of RM6.22mil and net margin of 30.7%; revenue rose 17.1% QoQ, net income rose 39.4% QoQ, and net margin improved from 25.8% in the prior quarter.
